risks.title: Risks related to global macroeconomic conditions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned first in the document (Item 1A) and uses strong language ('materially adverse impact'). It is weighted by the importance of economic conditions on discretionary purchases.

risks.title: Risks related to trade policies and tariffs
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed extensively in the 'Macroeconomic Conditions' section and explicitly mentions 'additional tariffs' and 'trade restrictions'. The projected impact on operating margin is 230 basis points in fiscal 2026.

risks.title: Risks related to global supply chain
risks.score_rationale: This risk is described in detail in the 'Risks Related to our Business and our Industry' section and covers multiple critical points such as delivery disruptions and logistics costs. Dependence on international production is high.

risks.title: Risks related to brand reputation and fashion trends
risks.score_rationale: This risk is well developed and underscores the importance of brand image and responsiveness to trends ('changing consumer preferences and fashion trends'). Failure can have a 'materially adverse' impact.

risks.title: Risks related to international operations and geopolitical instability
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in 'Risks Related to our Business and our Industry' and highlights exposure to political instability, health crises and regulatory changes in key markets (40% of sales outside US).

risks.title: Risks related to omnichannel and digital strategy
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in the growth and expansion section, mentioning reliance on technologies and third-party partners ('reliance on third-party digital partners'). Execution of this strategy is critical.

risks.title: Risks related to regulatory compliance and supplier practices
risks.score_rationale: This risk is addressed in the supply chain section and mentions compliance with laws ('labor laws', 'environmental regulations', 'FCPA'). Violations by suppliers can have serious consequences.

ai_positioning.summary: Company TPR does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report.
